tactical_thesis: Keep Fang permanently in the upper inner lane and Steward permanently in a central firing position. Replace Spot with Durin: Durin supplies the missing artillery damage, withdraws before a locked splash lands, and returns to shorten Midnight's late officer fights. Separate the two physicians and deliberately assign Hibiscus one isolated artillery hit. This is a complete, unsimulated current-model hypothesis; packet-level healing, artillery hit counts and lower-lane capacity remain acceptance-critical predictions.
